entries.calling.river-runner.addReason: Needs Grace 10 or more and Might 8 or more.
entries.choice.added-talent-lantern-bearer.title: Talent
entries.choice.added-talent-lantern-bearer.quest: What do you learn in your new calling?
entries.choice.added-talent-lantern-bearer.intro: You add the Lantern Bearer calling. You learn 1 [[glossary:talent|talent]] from its list. Someone who starts with this calling learns more.

entries.value.lanternKnackHit.name: Hit with lantern knacks

entries.value.rootKnackTarget.name: Target of your root knacks
entries.value.rootKnackHit.name: Hit with root knacks
entries.value.glowLevel.name: Glow level
entries.value.glowLevel.explain: Your levels as a Lantern Bearer, plus half your levels as a Herbalist, rounded up. Your glow slots follow it.
entries.value.lanternKnackRank.name: Highest rank of lantern knacks
entries.value.lanternKnackRank.explain: You learn lantern knacks up to this rank. It grows with your levels as a Lantern Bearer.
entries.value.rootKnackRank.name: Highest rank of root knacks
entries.value.rootKnackRank.explain: You learn root knacks up to this rank. It grows with your levels as a Herbalist.
entries.value.currentSlots.name: Current slots
entries.value.currentSlots.explain: How often you work a current knack before you need a rest. Apart from your glow slots.
entries.value.currentSlotRank.name: Rank of current slots
entries.value.currentSlotRank.explain: Every current slot has this rank. You also learn current knacks up to this rank.
entries.sheet.current-slots.title: Current slots
entries.sheet.current-slots.hint: ○ = one current knack, always at the rank beside it. Tick it. Erase after a rest.
